articles.title: Caledonia Mining, Strategic Minerals, Tooru, Galliford Try, Arrow Exploration, Buccaneer Energy
articles.summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation PLC (AIM:CMCL, NYSE-A:CMCL, VFEX:CMCL) says production at its Blanket mine in Zimbabwe is back to normal after a disrupted third quarter. Revenue rose 10.5% on a higher gold price, though a non-cash derivatives loss cut profit after tax by 39%. Strategic Minerals PLC (AIM:SML) has added six metallurgical holes to its drilling plans at Redmoor in Cornwall. It’s bringing forward tests of how much tungsten, copper, tin and silver it can recover. Tooru PLC (AIM:TOO, FRA:73N) has secured a listing with a major UK retailer for one of its health and wellness brands. The CEO is keeping the names of the brand and the retailer confidential, with a launch expected in Q1 2027. Galliford Try Holdings PLC (LSE:GFRD, FRA:3WC) says trading is slightly ahead of expectations in the new financial year. It’s also won places on all 10 lots of a £2 billion public buildings framework. Arrow Exploration Corp (TSX-V:AXL, AIM:AXL, OTC:CSTPF) has lifted production to a record of more than 7,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day. Its latest Icaco well is adding around 1,200 barrels a day net. Buccaneer Energy Plc (AIM:BUCE, FRA:LMU1) has secured £510,000 to restore full production at its Pine Mills oilfield in Texas.
